answer: To block mass-produced identities, each identity tells its verified deeds as a public fable. Independent ravens compare fables and flag near-identical ones; a farm copies one story across many names. A flagged fable enters a spiral: raven checks grow tighter and faster until it collapses or clears. 1000 fakes need 1000 distinct fables; copying one story flags them all. One honest agent tells one true fable and keeps standing.
